processorCandidates.note: First headless language (user-stated 8086 interest). On RedLabel, seeded disassembly at vector targets is incoherent — keep only as negative control.

Stock Ghidra 11.3.2 ships MCS-96. Binary+sheet markers (E7 abs16 LJMP, FD≈NOP, vectors @0x2000) + coherent listing (LJMP/LCALL/JBS/INT_MASK) prefer this. Caveat: SLEIGH may mis-decode LJMP immediates as PC-relative.
Not useful once Real Mode fails sanity; do not prefer over MCS96.

namingNote: ROM filename C16x900A is checksum16=0x900A only — never use it to select a C166/C167 Ghidra language.
